title: Questions on Skills and enemy names

posts.author: Balthazar
posts.body:
I'm thinking of adding an all out attack skill that reduces the user's defense for the rest of the turn and an attack that makes the user attack first regardless of agility differences. Anyone know how I could do that?
As for enemy names I want to make it so that when the enemy's HP reaches 50% their name changes to yellow and when it's below 25% it changes to red. Anyone know if there's a plugin for that or if I could simply code that in myself?
Thanks in advance.

posts.author: Kenen
posts.body:
1. It would be helpful if you described the skills and their effects in more detail. "All out attack skill" means nothing to us.
2. What enemy names? Enemy names show up in battle in a couple of places by default, but you may also be using plugins that add new instances where the enemy name is displayed. It would be helpful if you posted a screenshot showing the specific instance of text you are referring to. Otherwise, if you are using custom plugins, someone would have to spend several replies trying to coerce said plugin(s) out of you.

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
Create a state for the debuff.  You can make it last as many turns as you want.
In the damage formula :
a.addState(x); damage formula
x is the state id from the data base.

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
For future reference, there is an alternative.
a.addDebuff(paramID, turns)
Param ids start at zero, not one.  Defence, therefore, is id 3, not id 4 as you might expect looking at the list.  If you want the debuff to last e.g. 2 turns it would be:
a.addDebuff(3, 2); damage formula
I tend not to use this because I can make the states exactly as I want.  For example, the standard debuff rate is 25%.  But I might want 20% or 30% or whatever.
